methodology.expression: Converted value = input bytes ÷ target-unit bytes
methodology.description: Binary IEC storage-unit conversion using 1024-based multiples.

sources.label: NIST — Binary prefixes
sources.note: IEC binary prefixes distinguish 1024-based units such as MiB and GiB from decimal SI MB and GB.

sourceResponse.limitations: Positive-value IEC binary storage conversion among B, KiB, MiB, GiB and TiB only. Decimal/bit units are not offered.

methodology.description: Provider-neutral monthly storage estimate using a user-supplied unit price.
